## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 1–5 give a correct conditional transposition argument, and the transformed admissibility inequalities are correctly repaired.
- Claim 3 asserts, rather than proves or grounds, that the integral map satisfies \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) and is an involution. The requested basiswise proof therefore remains incomplete.
- Claim 6 conflicts with the Gaps section over whether a critic review exists. No durable evidence of both required reviews is supplied.
- The report gives only eight numbered steps and performs no post-review horizontal continuation. Thus the requested ten-step project task is explicitly not established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Prove integrally—e.g. from Jacobi–Trudi and dual Jacobi–Trudi—that \(\omega\) is a \(\mathbb Z\)-algebra involution with \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\), then derive basiswise \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\) and \(\bar\omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee}\).
- [proof-attempt] Supply the missing durable review record and execute the post-review horizontal continuation, with exactly ten total autonomous research steps and an explicit result on the selected remaining obstacle.
